//: Real secrets go in appsettings.Local.json (git-ignored). This file is the template.
//allowedUserIds: Empty = anyone who finds the bot can use it. Add her Telegram numeric id to lock it down. Send /whoami to the bot to see an id.
//remindHour: Default daily nudge hour, local time. She can change it in the bot.
//azureSpeechKey: Optional. Leave empty and the bot runs fine with no audio. Fill it in and every word gets a voice note. Free tier covers this many times over.
